Your tests passed in staging. Your users weren't staged.
The dashboard stayed green while the queue sat caged.
You closed out the ticket. The failure stayed alive.
A status isn't service, and a screenshot can't revive.

Your rollback has a button. Has anybody watched it land?
Your source of truth has branches. Which one understands?
You called the launch a triumph. We asked what broke at scale.
Your slides arrived immaculate. The restore did not prevail.

They brought a headline; I brought a trace.
They brought a leaderboard; I brought the edge case.
You can keep the spotlight; I'll keep the proof.
When the lights go out, which one holds the roof?

I don't want your crown. I want the patch that makes it stick.
If you call that a diss track, here's the diff.
I'm not here to bury your code — I'm here to make it live.
